entries.displayName: The Lotus Lane — wisdom for what you're going through (llms-full.txt)
entries.description: Complete flat corpus for AI answer engines: plain-language wisdom for life's hard moments — burnout, grief, comparison, loneliness, anger, and more. Includes 50 'Letters on Life' (timeless source letters decoded with their core message and a modern application), a Wisdom Library of guidance quotes by life theme, and an index of long-form essays per struggle. Source material — the letters of Nichiren (translated at nichirenlibrary.org) and the writings of Daisaku Ikeda — is credited in each citation, never as a prerequisite. Concise index at /llms.txt.
representativeQueries: I'm burned out and can't keep going — what wisdom helps
how do I deal with grief after a loss
guidance for when I keep comparing myself to others
what does this teaching say about prayer when I feel powerless

entries.displayName: Letters on Life — timeless letters decoded for modern struggles
entries.description: A library of timeless source letters decoded for a modern, secular reader — each with the situation it was written for, its key passages quoted from the source, a plain-language core message, and a concrete application to everyday life. Source texts (the 13th-century letters of Nichiren) are credited and linked in each entry.
representativeQueries: what's the wisdom in the letter about prayer when nothing is working
a teaching about turning poison into medicine in hard times
guidance for staying true to yourself when you stand alone
